BUNDLED YT-DLP WINDOWS X64 DISTRIBUTION

This JAR redistributes the unmodified official yt-dlp standalone executable
as a separate subprocess program. It includes Python, PyInstaller bootloader
files, third-party Python/native libraries and bundled EJS scripts. These
components are NOT covered by JMusicBot's Apache-2.0 project license.

Version: yt-dlp nightly 2026.10.10.233141
Binary: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-nightly-builds/releases/download/2026.10.10.233141/yt-dlp.exe
Binary SHA-256: e7cafc44db8aa433da8dd78303b9157f2c1dd509c4cbfcd8418081b7e1d26a7a
Release: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp-nightly-builds/releases/tag/2026.10.10.233141

LICENSES

Upstream explicitly licenses the PyInstaller-bundled combined executable
under GNU GPL version 3 or later. The yt-dlp source alone is Unlicense; that
is NOT the license of the standalone combined executable.
Upstream declaration: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/897341241f2bfb2439fe0367f4c7c9ccd29a3828/README.md#licensing

LICENSE.txt is the exact yt-dlp source Unlicense notice.
THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt is the complete upstream aggregated third-party
license material at the source revision above, including the GPLv3 text,
Python/PSF, Microsoft Windows distributable-code conditions, GPL/LGPL,
MPL, native-library, dependency and EJS/Meriyah/Astring license texts.
It is retained intact; some upstream-listed libraries apply only to other
platform builds, as indicated within that file.
PYINSTALLER_COPYING.txt is the exact PyInstaller 6.22.0 copyright, GPLv2+
terms, bootloader exception and runtime-hook licensing notice. PyInstaller's
bootloader exception must not be confused with the licensing of other
components in the combined executable.

CORRESPONDING SOURCE AND BUILD PROVENANCE

For the GPL-covered combined executable, recipients may access the source
without charge using the pinned source locations below and the complete
pinned dependency source inventory in COMPONENT_SOURCES.txt. Source access
includes the upstream build instructions/scripts and versioned dependencies,
not merely yt-dlp's Unlicense source. No component was modified by JMusicBot.

UPSTREAM_BUILD_WORKFLOW.txt preserves the upstream build workflow at the
pinned yt-dlp revision. Its windows/x64 job uses Python 3.10, installs the
hash-pinned build and runtime requirements, updates the release version,
generates lazy extractors, then invokes python -m bundle.pyinstaller.
Full scripts: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/tree/897341241f2bfb2439fe0367f4c7c9ccd29a3828/bundle
Release preparation: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/tree/897341241f2bfb2439fe0367f4c7c9ccd29a3828/devscripts
WINDOWS_BUILD_REQUIREMENTS.txt and WINDOWS_RUNTIME_REQUIREMENTS.txt preserve
the exact upstream requirement versions, package hashes and platform selectors.
COMPONENT_SOURCES.txt provides versioned source archives and SHA-256 values
for those runtime dependencies (including GPL-covered mutagen 1.48.1 and
EJS 0.8.0). Source packages include their own license and build material.
Python source releases: https://www.python.org/downloads/source/

Pinned PyInstaller build release: https://github.com/yt-dlp/Pyinstaller-Builds/releases/tag/2026.08.19.215425
PyInstaller source revision: 70fc17210920bce17f4ab09bbf8104b0dbd45338
PyInstaller source: https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller/tree/70fc17210920bce17f4ab09bbf8104b0dbd45338
PyInstaller source archive: https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller/archive/70fc17210920bce17f4ab09bbf8104b0dbd45338.tar.gz
PyInstaller bootloader build instructions: https://github.com/pyinstaller/pyinstaller/blob/70fc17210920bce17f4ab09bbf8104b0dbd45338/doc/bootloader-building.rst

Native-library source project locations and any upstream source-provision
contact are preserved in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt. In particular, upstream
states that if bundled third-party source cannot be obtained, its maintainers
will provide it per their license obligation at maintainers@yt-dlp.org. This
is an upstream statement, not a written source offer made by JMusicBot.

Redistributors must retain these notices and satisfy the applicable GPL
corresponding-source access obligations (including GPLv3 section 6 when
conveying object code). Source downloads on upstream servers are identified
here alongside the binary. Redistributors remain responsible for equivalent
source access for the required period and must host corresponding source if
these upstream locations cease to supply it; an unavailable URL or a license
notice alone does not satisfy that obligation. This notice does not impose
JMusicBot's Apache license on the bundled programs or replace their licenses.
